briefings.title: Meta’s $200 AI Agent ‘Hatch’, Sam Altman-back Helion Valuation Hits $15.5B, Snowflake’s New AI Tools

people.name: Jason Dean
people.role: San Francisco Bureau Chief, The Information

briefings.tldr: Meta is internally planning a consumer-focused AI agent named "Hatch" targeting a $200-a-month premium tier, while Sam Altman-backed fusion energy startup Helion has raised $465 million at a $15.5 billion valuation to accelerate its power plant manufacturing.

briefings.title: Ross Gerber on Elon Musk & Tesla’s 16% Revenue Growth, Google Cloud Next Conference, AI Insurance
briefings.tldr: Tesla faces scrutiny over narrow profitability and CEO Elon Musk's overextension, while the broader AI sector grapples with an "implementation gap" as corporations struggle to integrate agents and insurers move to exclude AI-related liabilities.

briefings.title: SpaceX’s Confidential IPO Filing, Blackstone’s Sell-off Opportunity, Crypto Crash Theory
briefings.tldr: SpaceX is pursuing a confidential IPO with a projected $1.75 trillion valuation driven by Starlink’s massive margins, while shifting speculative capital from crypto to prediction markets and a stabilization in private credit suggest a maturing but high-risk investment landscape.
